_purpose: Test kubectl subprocess memory bounds for large cluster collection
_description: Regression fixture for large Kubernetes collection OOM prevention. This fixture simulates a cluster with extreme amounts of resources to test that kubectl subprocess execution correctly handles large outputs without causing OOM in the scheduler.
_usage: Load this fixture to test bounded kubectl execution: from k8s_diag_agent.collect.fixture_loader import load_fixture; large_cluster = load_fixture('lab/large_kubernetes_collection_regression.json')
_test_scenarios: Large pods list (10,000+ pods across all namespaces)

_expected_behavior.note: Output exceeding 50MiB should raise KubectlOutputTooLargeError. Scheduler retained output should stay bounded; child kubectl RSS is not hard-capped by this fixture alone. --chunk-size and --request-timeout should be automatically applied.

test_scenarios.name: large_pods_all_namespaces
test_scenarios.description: kubectl get pods --all-namespaces -o json with 15,000 pods

test_scenarios.name: large_events_all_namespaces
test_scenarios.description: kubectl get events -A -o json with 75,000 events

test_scenarios.name: small_targeted_collection
test_scenarios.description: kubectl get pods -n kube-system -o json with 50 pods

mitigation_recommendations: Apply label selectors to filter results
Implement streaming output size limits in subprocess execution
Prefer metadata/table/custom-columns for inventory over full JSON
Collect full JSON only for selected suspicious objects
